verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a public OpenAPI v3 spec with OAuth client-credentials auth, idempotency keys and rate-limit headers, so a real programmatic surface exists. However, create, update and delete operations require capabilities Harbor must explicitly grant, and the probe shows mainly read endpoints such as registered-agent deliveries. Nothing shows UI features like Entity/License/Tax/Records Manager, filing-requirement search, Compliance Navigator AI or annual-report filing are reachable via the API. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, default (ungated) write access, API coverage of license/tax/records/annual-report/filing-search features, independent hands-on corroboration.
